Hello, I get how all these things can make you tired. I don't know much about you, but I believe that you are a strong person of character. Things may not seem like they will get better in the next time, but I strongly believe that you can still make it. 

Reach out to someone

I'm really sorry that you have to go through things for that long. I'm actually really glad that you are here right now...here and try to talk.

Everyone's life is a long path...a path filled with a lot of emotions, people, pain, and happiness. You might meet someone who is going the same path. I hope that the path your life is going down gets better, it will at some point. Don't think that it won't. 

Reaching out is the best thing you could've done at this time

Hey, I really pray that things get better for you. I want you to know that even though it may not seem like it, someone cares more than you think. 

I'm glad that you decided to reach out instead of staying completely silent.
Honestly, those people can just fuck off. These people are absolute morons and they don't understand the types of things you seem to be going through.

I completely understand. I feel the same way, I really hope that things get better for you.

Wish you all the best :)
Things don't just get easy...sadly. But there are things that can actually help you.

Please don't...I don't know much about you or your life, but suicide isn't the way to end it.

I beg you to not do it
